author: Barrie Linch
text: Perhaps to add a little balance, I have been using Libre constantly, since it first launched in the UK, in 2014. In all that time, using the Libre 1, libre 2 and now Libre 2 Plus, I have had very few issues with it and these have been dealt with by the company immediately.

author: Jim Gibbs
text: I had no real issues in 2 years of using the Libre 2 until they announced it was being discontinued. Since then out of the last 8 only 2 have made it 14 days. I talked with Abbott and they confirmed the sensors were bad not user error. I discussed with my Dr. and he said other patients have been having issues also. He went ahead and wrote a prescription for the Libre3 +. Haven't started using it yet as I have a couple of months of the 2 left.
